description: This file defines the FormField class, which models a form element within the OpenMRS system. It includes properties such as form association, parent/child relationships, position, and constraints. The class also provides comparison logic for sorting form fields and manages serialization.

classes.name: FormField
classes.description: Represents a form field within the OpenMRS system; encapsulates metadata and hierarchical relations for form rendering and data collection.

classes.name: FormField.DefaultComparator
classes.description: Provides default comparison logic for ordering FormField instances based on weight, page, field number, part, and ID.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Defines the comparison logic to sort FormField objects based on sort weight, page number, field number, field part, and ID.
